# Production-Hardening Checklist: Production Hardening

**Purpose**: Reviewer-owned requirements-quality gate for production-hardening across dependencies, HTTP contracts, validation, Result failures, localization, cache resilience, SQL safety, Keycloak, and regression.
**Created**: 2026-08-26
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [constitution](../../../.specify/memory/constitution.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Dependencies

- [ ] CHK001 Are both direct and transitive package-audit requirements specified, and is globally disabling that audit forbidden? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Are NU1903 (high) and NU1904 (critical) specified as build-failing findings, with unresolved high/critical runtime vulnerabilities forbidden when compatible fixes exist? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-004, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK003 Is blanket NuGet warning suppression explicitly forbidden, with remediation limited to upgrade, replacement, or documented risk treatment? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the prohibition of unnecessary prerelease runtime dependencies specified, including Redis instrumentation when project-owned telemetry can replace it, with automated proof that `LibraryManager` cache activities remain? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-006, Spec §Out of Scope]

## API Contracts

- [ ] CHK005 Is it specified that no controller source file may declare request or response transport types? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Spec §US2]
- [ ] CHK006 Are HTTP contracts required to live in `LibraryManager.Api` under feature-organized `Contracts/<Feature>/Requests` and `Contracts/<Feature>/Responses` directories, with list/history envelopes as API `PagedResponse<T>` (not Application `PagedResult<T>`)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Spec §Assumptions]

## Controllers

- [ ] CHK007 Are controllers forbidden from manual simple transport validation and from inspecting ModelState when model validation can enforce the rule first? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK008 Does Create Loan require a readonly strongly typed `IdempotencyKey` via `[FromIdempotencyKey]`, and is a nullable raw `string`/`string?` header argument forbidden? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, Key Entities §IdempotencyKey]
- [ ] CHK009 Are `Required` and `StringLength` annotations forbidden on the Idempotency-Key action parameter, including inside `LoansController`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018]

## Model Binding

- [ ] CHK010 Does the spec require a dedicated readonly `IdempotencyKey` API value, a custom `IModelBinder`, and `FromIdempotencyKeyAttribute` as the binding surface? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, Spec §FR-016, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK011 Are missing, empty, and whitespace-only Idempotency-Key headers specified as ModelState validation failures rather than use-case execution? [Coverage, Spec §FR-016, Spec §FR-017, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the length boundary specified so values longer than 128 characters fail ModelState while values of length 128 remain valid? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK013 Is normalization (trim) of a valid Idempotency-Key specified before the typed value is created, and is that trimmed value the one used for idempotency ownership? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK014 Is invalid binding specified to prevent `CreateLoanUseCase` execution, with `[ApiController]` producing automatic HTTP 400 and localized model-binding messages? [Consistency, Spec §FR-017, Spec §FR-030, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK015 Are middleware, action-filter, and `IParsable`-only approaches explicitly rejected for Idempotency-Key validation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019, Spec §Assumptions]

## Body Validation

- [ ] CHK016 Are request-body contracts specified to use API model validation (including DataAnnotations where appropriate) for simple transport constraints? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK017 Are request-body validation messages required to be localized at the API boundary? [Completeness, Spec §FR-030, Spec §US4]

## Result Pattern

- [ ] CHK018 Are expected Domain and Application outcomes forbidden from using exceptions as normal control flow, and are `Result`/`Result<T>`, `Error`, and `ErrorType` required? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK019 Are Result errors required to carry stable language-neutral codes, with localization occurring only at the API boundary? [Consistency, Spec §FR-022, Spec §FR-028, Spec §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK020 Are HTTP status semantics specified without conflict: Validation → 400, NotFound → 404, BusinessRule → 422, Conflict → 409 (409 reserved for Idempotency-Key canonical mismatch)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-024, Spec §SC-004, Spec §Assumptions]

## Domain Validation

- [ ] CHK021 Is repetitive domain if/throw validation boilerplate specified for replacement by reusable lightweight Domain rules? [Completeness, Spec §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK022 Does `AuditEvent.Create` (and other expected-failure factories) require `Result`/`Result<T>` rather than `DomainException` for expected field validation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK023 Is Domain validation specified to have no ASP.NET Core, localization, or Infrastructure dependencies? [Completeness, Spec §FR-028, Constitution X]

## Exception Handling

- [ ] CHK024 Is `IExceptionHandler` specified as the single HTTP boundary for unexpected failures, with unexpected technical exceptions still propagating there? [Completeness, Spec §FR-032, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK025 Are expected Result failures forbidden from being thrown merely to reach that handler? [Consistency, Spec §FR-023, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 Must unexpected error responses include `CorrelationId` and omit stack traces and other sensitive internals? [Completeness, Spec §FR-033, Spec §SC-006]

## Localization

- [ ] CHK027 Are `en-US` and `pt-BR` both specified as supported cultures, with `en-US` the default and `Accept-Language` the primary selector? [Completeness, Spec §FR-029, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK028 Are structured log templates, metric names, trace identifiers, error codes, and operational logs required to remain stable English values? [Clarity, Spec §FR-031, Constitution XI]
- [ ] CHK029 Is unsupported or omitted `Accept-Language` specified to fall back to `en-US`? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §Assumptions]

## Cache Resilience

- [ ] CHK030 Is Application forbidden from broad Redis recovery try/catch, with Infrastructure resilience required via the Decorator Pattern around `IAvailabilityCache`/`RedisAvailabilityCache`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-034, Spec §FR-036]
- [ ] CHK031 Are Redis GET failure as cache miss, Redis SET/REMOVE failure as non-fatal for committed catalog work, PostgreSQL-backed availability when Redis is down, and REMOVE failure recording `library_manager_cache_invalidation_failures` all specified together? [Consistency, Spec §FR-037, Spec §FR-038, Spec §FR-039, Spec §FR-040, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK032 Is `OperationCanceledException` specified never to be swallowed, including through cache-resilience code? [Completeness, Spec §FR-035, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK033 Must successful `DeactivateBook` invalidate availability cache after commit and persist `BookAvailabilityChanged` in the same PostgreSQL transaction as the mutation and `AuditEvent`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-041, Spec §FR-042, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK034 Is a previously cached active availability value forbidden from remaining observable after successful deactivation? [Coverage, Spec §FR-043, Spec §Edge Cases]

## SQL Safety

- [ ] CHK035 Are all runtime SQL values required to use database parameters, with runtime string concatenation into SQL forbidden? [Completeness, Spec §FR-044, Spec §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK036 Are existing safe `ExecuteSqlInterpolated`/`ExecuteSqlInterpolatedAsync` calls accepted as parameterized and forbidden from being rewritten merely because interpolation syntax is present? [Clarity, Spec §FR-045, Spec §FR-046]

## Keycloak

- [ ] CHK037 Are Direct Access Grants specified as disabled, is Resource Owner Password Credentials usage forbidden in README, 001 quickstart, and smoke tests, and is `dotnet test` specified to prove that via realm JSON rather than a live Keycloak process? [Completeness, Spec §FR-047, Spec §FR-048, Spec §SC-010]
- [ ] CHK038 Is Swagger authentication required to remain Authorization Code with PKCE exclusively? [Consistency, Spec §FR-049, Constitution Security]

## Regression

- [ ] CHK039 Are existing concurrency, idempotency, Outbox, authentication/JWT, and health automated tests required to remain compatible except where this feature explicitly changes transport validation behavior? [Consistency, Spec §FR-050, Spec §FR-051, Spec §SC-011, Spec §US9]
- [ ] CHK040 Is automated coverage required for every new hardening requirement in this specification, including the listed dependency, contract, binding, Result, localization, cache, SQL, and Keycloak rules? [Coverage, Spec §FR-051, Spec §SC-011]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK041 Do HTTP 400 transport-validation outcomes remain distinct from HTTP 422 business-rule and HTTP 409 idempotency-conflict outcomes, with no leftover requirement that maps expected Domain failures through `DomainException` to HTTP 400? [Conflict, Spec §FR-024, Spec §FR-025, Spec §001 compatibility]
- [ ] CHK042 Is Idempotency-Key specified as HTTP metadata (not a Domain concept) consistently across entities, Create Loan binding, and durable PostgreSQL idempotency ownership? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, Key Entities §IdempotencyKey, Spec §Assumptions]
